- **Lenticular** (`lumenary:lenticular`, models this process): A lenticular print is a sheet of tiny cylindrical lenses over two pictures that have been cut into thin strips and interlaced. Each lens sends one strip to your eye from one angle and the other strip from another, so as you move, the picture flips.
